invariants: Compatibility calculation values and interpretation content are separate layers.
Interpretation consumes exact-match state but never changes leftValue, rightValue, absoluteDifference or exactMatchCount.
The catalog requires exactly match+difference content for all six compatibility metrics.
TR and EN are explicit independent fields; unsupported locale tags fail closed instead of falling back silently.
Blank locale text, unresolved placeholders and duplicate rule IDs are rejected before interpretation.
No hidden percentage or weighting is introduced by the interpretation layer.
remaining_before_done: Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
Production editorial TR and EN compatibility copy must be supplied and independently reviewed; test fixture text is not production content.
Final TR/EN content coverage and repetition/quality audit must pass before user-facing interpretation is DONE.
